Messages.Author: Raille
Messages.Body:
If the weapon is not dodged the bearer gets a press to continue.

The text in part:
If this weapon is used to strike at close range and th eopponent doesn't
dodge the strike, the bearer gets an optional press.

So if I strike each round with the Meat Hook, I could get unlimited
presses until one minion is in torpor.

Is this correct?

Raille
